security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code formatting, documentation links, and safe shell arithmetic. Confirmed risks include mutable package installation and an unvalidated pet name that can redirect local writes. The workflow also sends image data to a third-party service.

remediation.issue: PET_NAME is used in output and installation paths without validation.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only a short slug, resolve the destination, and verify it remains inside the Codex pets directory before writing.

remediation.issue: The workflow sends a source image URL and prompt to RunComfy for remote processing.
remediation.suggestion: Request confirmation before transfer, reject private or signed URLs, and document endpoint, retention, and deletion policies.

remediation.issue: Setup instructions execute mutable packages through npx, npm, Homebrew, or apt.
remediation.suggestion: Pin reviewed package versions, publish checksums where possible, and require confirmation before global or system-level installation.

content.user_title: Create a Custom Codex Pet from One Image
content.value_statement: Custom Codex Pet atlases are difficult to size, animate, and install correctly. This skill generates one canonical sprite and assembles the required atlas and manifest.
actual_capabilities: Generates one canonical pet sprite from a public reference image URL.
Normalizes the sprite into transparent 192 by 208 pixel cells.
Builds nine animation rows with fixed frame counts and transparent trailing cells.
Composes a 1536 by 1872 WebP atlas using ImageMagick.
Creates the pet manifest and installs both files in the Codex pets directory.
limitations: Requires a RunComfy account, authentication token, RunComfy CLI, and ImageMagick.
Sends the source image URL and generation prompt to a third-party service.
Uses transforms of one pose, so it cannot create complex frame-by-frame motion.
Chroma-key removal can damage near-magenta details, and generated identity may drift.

use_cases.title: Personal Desktop Companion
use_cases.description: Turn a portrait, mascot, or object into a pet for a personal Codex installation.

use_cases.title: Team Mascot Pack
use_cases.description: Create consistent pets from approved brand images for team members who use Codex.

use_cases.title: Repeatable Pet Production
use_cases.description: Apply the same atlas recipe to several source images while reviewing each generated pose.

prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Codex Pet named {safe_slug} from {public_image_url}. Use the default style and install it after I approve the preview.
prompt_templates.scenario: First pet with default animation settings

prompt_templates.title: Preserve Key Features
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Codex Pet from {public_image_url}. Preserve {identity_features}, avoid magenta details, and show the canonical pose before atlas assembly.
prompt_templates.scenario: Portrait or mascot requiring stronger identity

prompt_templates.title: Tune the Animation
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a pet named {safe_slug}. Use {public_image_url}, increase the jump slightly, and keep all other motion subtle.
prompt_templates.scenario: Custom movement within the fixed atlas contract

prompt_templates.title: Produce an Approved Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate pets for these public image URLs. Use unique safe slugs, review every canonical pose, and install only approved results.

output: Generated a canonical chibi sprite for review.
Built all nine animation rows in the required atlas dimensions.
Installed the approved atlas and manifest as refactor-buddy.

output_examples.input: Keep the glasses and red scarf, but make the idle motion quieter.
output_examples.output: Preserved the requested features and reduced idle movement while retaining the required six idle frames.

output_examples.input: Create three pets from these public team mascot images.
output_examples.output: Prepared three separate pet atlases with unique safe names and paused for approval before installation.

best_practices: Use a public, non-sensitive image URL and confirm third-party processing before generation.
Choose a short lowercase slug and verify the resolved installation path before writing files.
Review the canonical sprite before building the atlas because later steps reuse that pose.
anti_patterns: Do not use private, signed, or internal image URLs for remote processing.
Do not place unvalidated user text into shell variables or destination paths.
Do not increase movement beyond the fixed cell boundaries or required frame counts.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a Codex-compatible WebP sprite atlas and a pet manifest from one reference image.

faq.question: Which tools are required?
faq.answer: You need the RunComfy CLI, RunComfy authentication, ImageMagick, and a public HTTPS image URL.

faq.question: Does the source image stay local?
faq.answer: No. RunComfy receives the source URL and fetches the image for remote model processing.

faq.question: How complex are the animations?
faq.answer: The skill applies small shifts, rotations, mirroring, and blink edits to one canonical pose.

faq.question: Can I customize the animation?
faq.answer: Yes. You can adjust small movement values while preserving cell dimensions and required frame counts.

faq.question: Where are completed pets installed?
faq.answer: They are installed under the configured Codex home pets directory after path validation and approval.
